name: Yuri
source:
Belongs to Crobidoll's adult B-line. Yuri was released with a sexy drummer concept who's meant to satisfy all women.

A narcissist, Yuri has the most mature body amongst the dolls. He has the tendency to flirt with Eri 24/7 and he may look frivolous, but in reality Yuri is a serious man when he's alone with Eri.

Hobbies: Drumming, shopping
Likes: Women who like him
Dislikes: Frigid people
